clips.title: The story
paras: At Razor Hill, Gar'Thok directs recruits leaving the Valley of Trials to secure Durotar. The veteran orc warrior survived the Kul Tiras landings on Durotar's coast and now coordinates defense against human encroachers and native threats.

After the Third War, Gar'Thok marched to Durotar under Warchief Thrall and served as a lieutenant under Nazgrel during the first days of building the new homeland. When Rexxar, the half-ogre wanderer, arrived in Durotar, Gar'Thok warned him that quilboar were raiding the settlement's perimeter. He enlisted the beastmaster to protect the fragile new settlement.

Gar'Thok's resolve was tested when Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore's Kul Tiras fleet landed on Durotar's eastern shores. At an outlying watch post, Gar'Thok saw naval marines overwhelm and slaughter his garrison. His forces were decimated, but he survived. The surprise assault left him vigilant against the surviving marines, who still occupy Tiragarde Keep and the coastal shipwrecks.

From the barracks at Razor Hill, Gar'Thok oversees the defense of central Durotar. He quickly sends emerging Horde warriors, shamans, and scouts to drive out hostile Kul Tiran remnants, repossess salvaged supplies, and recover military orders left in the coastal ruins. Durotar's safety is far from assured, and Gar'Thok keeps pressure on those who challenge the Horde's right to this soil.
